questions.distractor_summary: DocumentDB is MongoDB-compatible, Keyspaces is Cassandra-compatible, and Timestream stores time-series data.

questions.subdomain: 3.4 Identify AWS database services
questions.question: A company needs to run complex analytical SQL queries across petabytes of structured data for business intelligence. Which service fits best?
options: Amazon RDS for MariaDB on a small instance
questions.correct_rationale: Redshift is a data warehouse designed for large-scale analytical queries.
questions.distractor_summary: DynamoDB is a key-value database, ElastiCache is a cache, and a small RDS instance is not built for petabyte analytics.

questions.subdomain: 3.4 Identify AWS database services
questions.question: Which service adds an in-memory cache to reduce database load and speed up reads?
questions.correct_rationale: ElastiCache runs managed Redis-compatible or Memcached caches that serve frequent reads from memory.
questions.distractor_summary: Glacier is archival storage, Backup protects data, and EBS is block storage.

questions.subdomain: 3.4 Identify AWS database services
questions.question: A company wants to move its on-premises database to AWS with minimal downtime. Which service helps migrate the data?
questions.correct_rationale: DMS migrates databases to AWS and can keep the source and target in sync during the move.
questions.distractor_summary: DataSync copies files rather than keeping databases in sync, Inspector scans vulnerabilities, and Artifact provides reports.

questions.subdomain: 3.4 Identify AWS database services
questions.question: What is a benefit of using a managed database such as Amazon RDS instead of installing a database on EC2?
options: The database becomes free of charge
AWS handles tasks such as backups, patching, and failover setup
The customer no longer controls who can access it
It removes the need for any database design
questions.correct_rationale: Managed databases offload routine administration to AWS while the customer focuses on data and access.
questions.distractor_summary: Managed databases are billed, access control stays with the customer, and design work is still needed.

questions.subdomain: 3.5 Identify AWS network services
questions.question: What is Amazon VPC?
options: A logically isolated virtual network in the AWS Cloud where you launch resources
A physical cable between data centers
questions.correct_rationale: A VPC lets you define your own IP ranges, subnets, route tables, and gateways.
questions.distractor_summary: CloudFront delivers content, Route 53 registers domains, and Direct Connect provides physical links.

questions.subdomain: 3.5 Identify AWS network services
questions.question: Which AWS service is a scalable DNS web service that can also register domain names?
questions.correct_rationale: Route 53 provides DNS, domain registration, and health-checked routing.
questions.distractor_summary: CloudFront is a CDN, Direct Connect is a private link, and API Gateway publishes APIs.

questions.subdomain: 3.5 Identify AWS network services
questions.question: A company serves videos to users worldwide and wants to reduce latency by caching content close to viewers. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: CloudFront caches content at edge locations so viewers get it from a nearby location.
questions.distractor_summary: VPC peering connects VPCs, VPN connects networks, and EBS is block storage.

questions.subdomain: 3.5 Identify AWS network services
questions.question: What does an internet gateway do in a VPC?
options: Encrypts all data stored in the VPC
Allows communication between resources in the VPC and the internet
Blocks all inbound traffic by default for every resource
questions.correct_rationale: An internet gateway is attached to a VPC so public subnets can reach the internet.
questions.distractor_summary: It does not encrypt storage, peering connects VPCs, and blocking traffic is done by security groups and ACLs.

questions.subdomain: 3.5 Identify AWS network services
questions.question: Instances in a private subnet need to download software updates from the internet without being reachable from the internet. What should be used?
options: An internet gateway attached directly to the private instances
A NAT gateway in a public subnet
questions.correct_rationale: A NAT gateway lets private resources start outbound connections while blocking unsolicited inbound connections.
questions.distractor_summary: An internet gateway route would make them public, Direct Connect links to on premises, and DNS does not provide outbound access.

questions.subdomain: 3.5 Identify AWS network services
questions.question: What is a subnet?
options: A copy of a VPC in another Region
A range of IP addresses within a VPC, placed in a single Availability Zone
A security group for multiple instances
questions.correct_rationale: Subnets divide a VPC's address range and each lives in one AZ.
questions.distractor_summary: Subnets are not Region copies, security groups, or DNS records.

questions.subdomain: 3.5 Identify AWS network services
questions.question: A global gaming company wants to improve performance for TCP and UDP traffic by routing users over the AWS global network to the nearest healthy endpoint, using static IP addresses. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: Global Accelerator provides static anycast IPs and routes traffic over the AWS backbone to the best endpoint.
questions.distractor_summary: Signed URLs control access to cached content, VPC endpoints give private access to services, and Transit Gateway connects VPCs and networks.

questions.subdomain: 3.5 Identify AWS network services
questions.question: Which service connects many VPCs and on-premises networks through a central hub?
questions.correct_rationale: Transit Gateway acts as a regional hub that simplifies connecting many networks.
questions.distractor_summary: CloudFront delivers content, Shield protects against DDoS, and Lightsail offers simple servers.

questions.subdomain: 3.5 Identify AWS network services
questions.question: A company wants instances in a VPC to reach Amazon S3 without using the internet. What should it use?
options: A VPC gateway endpoint for Amazon S3
questions.correct_rationale: Gateway endpoints route traffic to S3 over the AWS network without internet access.
questions.distractor_summary: An internet gateway uses the internet, Global Accelerator speeds public traffic, and health checks monitor endpoints.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: Which AWS service stores files as objects in buckets and offers very high durability?
questions.correct_rationale: S3 is object storage designed for 99.999999999 percent durability.
questions.distractor_summary: EBS is block storage, EFS is a shared file system, and instance store is temporary block storage.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: An EC2 instance needs a persistent block storage volume for its database that survives instance stops. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: EBS volumes persist independently of the instance's running state.
questions.distractor_summary: Glacier is archival object storage, instance store data is lost when the instance stops, and CloudFront is a CDN.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: Several Linux EC2 instances must read and write the same files at the same time. Which storage service fits best?
options: A single Amazon EBS gp3 volume attached to one instance
questions.correct_rationale: EFS is a managed NFS file system that many instances can mount at once.
questions.distractor_summary: A standard EBS volume attaches to one instance, Deep Archive is for rarely accessed archives, and instance store is local to one host.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: Which Amazon S3 storage class is the lowest cost for data that is rarely accessed and can wait up to 12 hours for retrieval?
questions.correct_rationale: Deep Archive is the cheapest class, designed for long-term retention with retrieval within hours.
questions.distractor_summary: Standard and Standard-IA cost more, and Express One Zone targets high-performance access.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: A company has data with unknown and changing access patterns and wants S3 to move objects between tiers automatically to save money. Which storage class fits best?
options: S3 Standard with no lifecycle rules
questions.correct_rationale: Intelligent-Tiering monitors access and moves objects to lower-cost tiers automatically.
questions.distractor_summary: One Zone-IA stores data in one AZ, a single Glacier class does not adapt, and Standard alone does not optimize cost.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: What does an S3 lifecycle policy do?
options: Encrypts objects with a customer key
Replicates buckets to every Region automatically
Transitions objects to other storage classes or deletes them after set times
Grants public read access to objects
questions.correct_rationale: Lifecycle rules automate moving objects to cheaper classes and expiring them.
questions.distractor_summary: Encryption, replication, and access are configured separately.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: A company wants to back up EBS volumes, RDS databases, and EFS file systems with one central policy. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: AWS Backup centrally manages and automates backups across many AWS services.
questions.distractor_summary: CloudWatch monitors, Config tracks configuration, and Inspector scans vulnerabilities.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: Which service gives on-premises applications access to virtually unlimited cloud storage through a local appliance?
questions.correct_rationale: Storage Gateway connects on-premises environments to AWS storage such as S3 through file, volume, or tape interfaces.
questions.distractor_summary: EBS is for EC2, Lambda runs code, and Lightsail offers simple servers.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: A company needs a fully managed Windows file system that supports SMB and Active Directory integration for Windows applications. Which service fits best?
options: Amazon FSx for Windows File Server
questions.correct_rationale: FSx for Windows File Server provides native Windows file shares with SMB and AD integration.
questions.distractor_summary: EFS uses NFS, S3 is object storage, and instance store is temporary local storage.

questions.subdomain: 3.6 Identify AWS storage services
questions.question: What happens to data on an EC2 instance store when the instance is stopped?
options: The data is copied to Amazon S3 automatically
The data is kept for 30 days
The data moves to an EBS volume
questions.correct_rationale: Instance store is temporary storage tied to the host and does not persist when the instance stops.
questions.distractor_summary: AWS does not copy instance store data anywhere automatically.

questions.subdomain: 3.7 Identify AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services and analytics services
questions.question: Which AWS service is a fully managed platform to build, train, and deploy machine learning models?
questions.correct_rationale: SageMaker AI provides tools for every step of building and deploying ML models.
questions.distractor_summary: Athena queries data in S3, QuickSight builds dashboards, and Glue prepares data.

questions.subdomain: 3.7 Identify AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services and analytics services
questions.question: A company wants to build a generative AI chatbot using foundation models through an API, without managing infrastructure. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: Bedrock gives access to foundation models from several providers through a managed API.
questions.distractor_summary: Rekognition analyzes images and video, Textract extracts text from documents, and Batch runs batch jobs.

questions.subdomain: 3.7 Identify AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services and analytics services
questions.question: Which service converts speech in audio files into text?
questions.correct_rationale: Transcribe performs automatic speech recognition.
questions.distractor_summary: Polly turns text into speech, Translate translates text, and Comprehend analyzes text.

questions.subdomain: 3.7 Identify AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services and analytics services
questions.question: Which service extracts printed text, handwriting, and data from scanned documents such as forms?
questions.correct_rationale: Textract reads text and structured data such as tables and form fields from documents.
questions.distractor_summary: Rekognition analyzes images, Lex builds chat interfaces, and Kendra is enterprise search.

questions.subdomain: 3.7 Identify AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services and analytics services
questions.question: A retailer wants to run SQL queries directly on log files stored in Amazon S3 and pay per query. Which service fits best?
options: Amazon EMR with a long-running cluster
questions.correct_rationale: Athena is serverless and queries data in S3 using SQL, charging by data scanned.
questions.distractor_summary: RDS and DynamoDB require loading data into databases, and a long-running EMR cluster adds management.

questions.subdomain: 3.7 Identify AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services and analytics services
questions.question: Which AWS service builds interactive business intelligence dashboards?
questions.correct_rationale: QuickSight is a BI service for dashboards and visualizations.
questions.distractor_summary: Kinesis streams data, the Glue Data Catalog stores metadata, and Polly creates speech.

questions.subdomain: 3.7 Identify AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services and analytics services
questions.question: A company needs to collect and process clickstream data in real time from thousands of sources. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: Kinesis Data Streams captures and processes streaming data in real time.
questions.distractor_summary: Glacier archives data, Artifact provides reports, and Lightsail runs simple servers.

questions.subdomain: 3.7 Identify AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services and analytics services
questions.question: Which service is a serverless data integration service used to discover, prepare, and combine data for analytics, including ETL jobs?
questions.correct_rationale: Glue crawls data, builds a data catalog, and runs extract, transform, and load jobs.
questions.distractor_summary: Redshift stores and queries data, Lex builds conversational interfaces, and Shield protects against DDoS.

questions.subdomain: 3.7 Identify AWS artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) services and analytics services
questions.question: Which service runs big data frameworks such as Apache Spark and Hadoop on managed clusters?
questions.correct_rationale: EMR provides managed clusters for open-source big data frameworks.
questions.distractor_summary: Athena is serverless SQL on S3, Lambda runs functions, and Neptune is a graph database.

questions.subdomain: 3.8 Identify services from other in-scope AWS service categories
questions.question: Which service sends notifications by email, SMS, or to other systems using a publish and subscribe model?
questions.correct_rationale: Amazon Simple Notification Service fans out messages to subscribers.
questions.distractor_summary: SQS is a queue, EBS is block storage, and Glue prepares data.

questions.subdomain: 3.8 Identify services from other in-scope AWS service categories
questions.question: An order system must buffer messages between a web tier and a processing tier so orders are not lost if processing slows down. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: SQS stores messages in a queue until the consumer processes them, decoupling the tiers.
questions.distractor_summary: SNS pushes notifications, Route 53 handles DNS, and Polly creates speech.

questions.subdomain: 3.8 Identify services from other in-scope AWS service categories
questions.question: Which AWS service provides a cloud contact center for customer service?
questions.correct_rationale: Amazon Connect is an omnichannel cloud contact center service.
questions.distractor_summary: WorkSpaces provides virtual desktops, Amplify builds web and mobile apps, and SES sends email.

questions.subdomain: 3.8 Identify services from other in-scope AWS service categories
questions.question: Developers want a fully managed service to build, test, and deploy code automatically each time they push changes. Which combination fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: CodePipeline automates release stages and CodeBuild compiles and tests code.
questions.distractor_summary: The other pairs are for speech, compliance, and content delivery.

questions.subdomain: 3.8 Identify services from other in-scope AWS service categories
questions.question: A company wants to view and act on operational data such as patch status and run commands across many EC2 instances. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: Systems Manager provides operations tools such as Run Command, Patch Manager, and Session Manager.
questions.distractor_summary: Macie finds sensitive data, Artifact provides reports, and Kendra is enterprise search.

questions.subdomain: 4.1 Compare AWS pricing models
questions.question: Which EC2 pricing option offers the deepest discount but can be interrupted when AWS needs the capacity back?
questions.correct_rationale: Spot Instances use spare capacity at large discounts and can be reclaimed with a two-minute warning.
questions.distractor_summary: On-Demand and Reserved Instances are not interrupted for capacity, and Dedicated Hosts are physical servers.

questions.subdomain: 4.1 Compare AWS pricing models
questions.question: A company runs a database server 24/7 and expects to keep it for three years. Which pricing option usually saves the most while keeping capacity stable?
options: A Reserved Instance or Savings Plan with a three-year commitment
questions.correct_rationale: Long commitments for steady workloads earn the largest discounts compared with On-Demand.
questions.distractor_summary: On-Demand has no discount, Spot can be interrupted, and the Free Tier is limited.

questions.subdomain: 4.1 Compare AWS pricing models
questions.question: Which pricing model offers lower prices in exchange for a commitment to a consistent amount of compute usage, measured in dollars per hour, for one or three years?
options: On-Demand Capacity Reservations with no commitment
Dedicated Instances billed per second only
questions.correct_rationale: Savings Plans give discounts for committing to an hourly spend over one or three years.
questions.distractor_summary: Spot uses spare capacity, Capacity Reservations reserve capacity at On-Demand rates, and Dedicated Instances describe tenancy.

questions.subdomain: 4.1 Compare AWS pricing models
questions.question: A batch job can be stopped and restarted at any time and must be as cheap as possible. Which EC2 option fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: Fault-tolerant, flexible workloads are ideal for Spot's deep discounts.
questions.distractor_summary: Dedicated Hosts and reservations add cost or commitment, and On-Demand costs more.

questions.subdomain: 4.1 Compare AWS pricing models
questions.question: Why might a company choose EC2 Dedicated Hosts?
options: To get the lowest possible price for any workload
To use existing server-bound software licenses or meet compliance rules that need a physical server for one customer
To avoid paying for compute while instances run
questions.correct_rationale: Dedicated Hosts give visibility into physical servers, which helps with some licenses and compliance needs.
questions.distractor_summary: They are not the cheapest option, compute is billed, and they are not Spot.

questions.subdomain: 4.1 Compare AWS pricing models
questions.question: Which data transfer is usually free on AWS?
options: Data transferred into AWS from the internet
Data transferred out of AWS to the internet
questions.correct_rationale: Inbound data transfer from the internet is generally not charged, while outbound and inter-Region transfer usually are.
questions.distractor_summary: Outbound and cross-Region transfer are typically billed, so not all transfer is free.

questions.subdomain: 4.1 Compare AWS pricing models
questions.question: How are AWS Lambda functions mainly priced?
options: By a fixed monthly fee per function
By the number of developers who write the code
By the number of AWS Regions used
By number of requests and the duration of execution based on memory size
questions.correct_rationale: Lambda charges for requests and compute time, which scales with allocated memory.
questions.distractor_summary: There is no fixed fee per function, and developer or Region counts do not set Lambda prices.

questions.subdomain: 4.1 Compare AWS pricing models
questions.question: A company has several AWS accounts in AWS Organizations, each with modest usage. How can it benefit from volume pricing tiers?
options: Create separate payment methods for each account
Move every workload into one account and delete the others
Use consolidated billing so usage across accounts is combined for tiered pricing
Buy more Reserved Instances in each account separately
questions.correct_rationale: Consolidated billing combines usage across member accounts, which can reach lower volume tiers sooner.
questions.distractor_summary: Separate payments do not combine usage, deleting accounts loses isolation, and separate purchases do not combine tiers.

questions.subdomain: 4.2 Understand resources for billing, budget, and cost management
questions.question: Which tool lets you visualize and analyze past AWS spending and forecast future costs?
questions.correct_rationale: Cost Explorer shows cost and usage trends with filtering and forecasting.
questions.distractor_summary: Pricing Calculator estimates planned costs, Artifact provides reports, and Inspector scans vulnerabilities.

questions.subdomain: 4.2 Understand resources for billing, budget, and cost management
questions.question: A manager wants an email alert when monthly AWS spending is forecast to exceed 1,000 US dollars. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: AWS Budgets sends alerts when actual or forecast costs or usage pass thresholds you set.
questions.distractor_summary: CloudTrail logs API calls, Macie finds sensitive data, and Shield protects against DDoS.

questions.subdomain: 4.2 Understand resources for billing, budget, and cost management
questions.question: What are cost allocation tags used for?
options: Grouping and tracking AWS costs by project, team, or environment in billing reports
questions.correct_rationale: After activation, tags appear in billing data so costs can be broken down by business dimension.
questions.distractor_summary: Tags used for cost allocation do not encrypt data, grant permissions, or choose Regions.

questions.subdomain: 4.2 Understand resources for billing, budget, and cost management
questions.question: A finance team needs the most detailed, line-item data about AWS usage and costs to load into its own analytics tools. What should it use?
options: AWS Trusted Advisor service limits only
AWS Cost and Usage Reports (or Data Exports) delivered to Amazon S3
questions.correct_rationale: Cost and Usage Reports provide the most comprehensive billing data, delivered to S3 for analysis.
questions.distractor_summary: The Health Dashboard shows service events, the credential report covers IAM users, and service limits do not detail costs.

questions.subdomain: 4.2 Understand resources for billing, budget, and cost management
questions.question: What is a benefit of AWS Organizations for billing?
options: Free usage of all services for member accounts
Removal of all data transfer charges
Consolidated billing with a single payment method for multiple accounts
questions.correct_rationale: Organizations lets one management account pay for all member accounts and see combined usage.
questions.distractor_summary: Member accounts still pay for usage, resources are not deleted automatically, and data transfer is still billed.

questions.subdomain: 4.2 Understand resources for billing, budget, and cost management
questions.question: A company wants recommendations to resize underused EC2 instances based on usage history. Which service fits best?
questions.correct_rationale: Compute Optimizer analyzes utilization and recommends better-fitting instance types and sizes.
questions.distractor_summary: Artifact provides reports, Polly creates speech, and Direct Connect is a network link.

questions.subdomain: 4.2 Understand resources for billing, budget, and cost management
questions.question: Which feature can automatically take actions, such as applying an IAM policy to stop new resources, when a budget threshold is reached?
questions.correct_rationale: Budgets actions run defined responses when spending passes thresholds.
questions.distractor_summary: Cost Explorer filters, calculator groups, and CloudFront price classes do not enforce budget responses.

questions.subdomain: 4.3 Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
questions.question: Which AWS Support plan is included for all customers at no additional cost?
questions.correct_rationale: Basic Support includes account and billing help, documentation, the Health Dashboard, and core Trusted Advisor checks.
questions.distractor_summary: The other plans are paid.

questions.subdomain: 4.3 Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
questions.question: A company runs mission-critical workloads and wants a designated technical account manager and the fastest response times for business-critical outages. Which plan fits best?
options: Enterprise Support (or Enterprise On-Ramp for a pooled TAM)
questions.correct_rationale: Enterprise-level plans include technical account managers and the fastest response targets for critical issues.
questions.distractor_summary: Basic and Developer plans do not include a TAM, and Business Support alone does not provide one.

questions.subdomain: 4.3 Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
questions.question: Which support plan is the lowest-cost paid option that gives business-hours email access to Cloud Support Associates, aimed at experimenting or testing?
questions.correct_rationale: Developer Support is intended for testing and early development with business-hours technical help.
questions.distractor_summary: Business and Enterprise plans cost more and offer 24/7 access, and Basic does not include technical case support.

questions.subdomain: 4.3 Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
questions.question: A company wants to find a consulting firm with AWS expertise to help design its migration. Where should it look?
questions.correct_rationale: The AWS Partner Network lists consulting and technology partners that can help customers.
questions.distractor_summary: Artifact provides reports, the Free Tier is a usage allowance, and Inspector scans vulnerabilities.

questions.subdomain: 4.3 Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
questions.question: Where can customers find official AWS answers to common technical questions and troubleshooting articles?
options: AWS Knowledge Center and AWS documentation
questions.correct_rationale: The Knowledge Center and documentation provide guidance on common questions and services.
questions.distractor_summary: Budgets, Organizations, and Connect are services, not knowledge resources.

questions.subdomain: 4.3 Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
questions.question: A startup wants hands-on help from AWS experts to plan an architecture, beyond what its support plan covers. Which AWS offering provides paid expert engagements?
questions.correct_rationale: AWS Professional Services is a team of experts customers can engage to help achieve business outcomes.
questions.distractor_summary: The other options are dashboards, automated checks, or usage allowances.

questions.subdomain: 4.3 Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
questions.question: Which resource offers community question-and-answer help from AWS users and experts?
questions.correct_rationale: re:Post is AWS's community Q&A site, with answers from the community and AWS experts.
questions.distractor_summary: Artifact provides reports, Cost Explorer analyzes spending, and Snowball transfers data.

questions.subdomain: 4.3 Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
questions.question: A company with Business Support wants access to all AWS Trusted Advisor checks. Which statement is accurate?
options: Only Basic Support includes all Trusted Advisor checks
Trusted Advisor checks are sold separately per check
Trusted Advisor is available only in one Region
Business, Enterprise On-Ramp, and Enterprise Support include the full set of Trusted Advisor checks
questions.correct_rationale: Higher support plans unlock the full set of Trusted Advisor checks, while Basic includes a core subset.
questions.distractor_summary: Basic has only core checks, checks are not sold individually, and Trusted Advisor is not limited to one Region.

questions.subdomain: 4.3 Identify AWS technical resources and AWS Support options
questions.question: What does the AWS Health Dashboard provide?
options: Your monthly bill broken down by tag
A list of IAM users without MFA
Information about AWS service events and scheduled changes that may affect your resources
questions.correct_rationale: The Health Dashboard shows general service status and personalized events for your account.
questions.distractor_summary: Billing breakdowns, IAM credential reports, and pricing estimates come from other tools.
